inside.description: every cell of a is in b

outside.description: no cell of a is in b

center.description: a sits at its parent's centre

corner.description: a sits in a corner of its parent

adjacent.description: a and b share an edge without overlapping

near.description: a is within d0 of b (score falls to 0 at d1)

far.description: a is at least d from b

away-from.description: a keeps at least d from b

in-front-of.description: a is in front of b, in b's facing frame

behind.description: a is behind b, in b's facing frame

beside.description: a is to the side of b

between.description: a lies on the segment between b and c

aligned.description: a lies along b, parallel to it (a car on its road, on its side of it)

symmetric.description: members are mirrored across the parent's axis

along.description: a runs along path or line b at an offset

encloses.description: line a closes a loop around region b (gaps only at gates)

path-between.description: a walkable route exists between a and b

visible-from.description: a straight line from anchor b to a crosses no blocking cell

focus.description: a closes the view along a straight path run leaving b

on.description: a stands on b's top surface

interest.description: the site's interest for a criterion at a's cells (-1 vetoes)

north-of.description: a lies above (north of) b on the map

south-of.description: a lies below (south of) b on the map

east-of.description: a lies right of (east of) b on the map

west-of.description: a lies left of (west of) b on the map

in-north.description: a lies in the north of the map (its top side); b is "site"

in-south.description: a lies in the south of the map (its bottom side); b is "site"

in-east.description: a lies in the east of the map (its right side); b is "site"

in-west.description: a lies in the west of the map (its left side); b is "site"

set-in.description: a fills a gap in b (a door in its wall)

mounted-on.description: a hangs on b (a torch on a wall)

against.description: a stands with its back to b (a chest against a wall)

leads-to.description: a connects here to b (stairs to another level, a gate to a road)

lights.description: a lights b (a lamp, a brazier)

part-of.description: a belongs to b (a counter of a shop, a pillar of a hall)

used-with.description: a is used with b (a chair at a table)

debris-of.description: a came from b (rubble of a wall)

coloured-by.description: a's art takes its colours from b (a wall from the background it stands on)

made-with.description: a's art is made together with b's, so they match (stairs with the walls they stand against): b's picture shown when a is painted
